title: EvalVSN: reinforcement learning agents in a cross-layer stack for video over wireless sensor networks
description: Supporting material for the article Reinforcement Learning Agents in a Cross-Layer Stack for Forest Fire Video Surveillance over Wireless Sensor Networks (M. Y. Baziz, L. Sekhri and B. Kechar), submitted to Sensors (MDPI), in the version of the revised manuscript: the ns-2.35 modules, the EvalVSN codec and evaluation chain, the simulation and measurement scripts, the results of every simulation of studies 09 and 10 with their seeds, the measurements behind the article, and the exact commands that reproduce them. The code is under GPL-3.0, the data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-data).
